verdict.rationale: Elicit ships a documented public API with dedicated docs (API keys, endpoints for Systematic Review with search/screening/extraction control) and explicit programmatic access to search 138M+ papers and generate reports from code/scripts, plus an equivalent MCP server for agent clients. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of API usage and no discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and API access is gated to certain pricing tiers.
